changes.en: Similar in texture, appearance and thickening power, and used in the same way. It breaks down less quickly and gives a slightly clearer sauce; the book notes that it costs much more.
changes.de: Ähnlich in Beschaffenheit, Aussehen und Dickungskraft und wird genauso verwendet. Es baut sich weniger schnell ab und ergibt eine etwas klarere Sauce; laut Buch kostet es deutlich mehr.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)

sources.sentence: is similar in texture, appearance and thickening power to cornstarch and is used in exactly the same manner.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 1.3 Sauces and Thickening Agents, section Arrowroot
sources.sentence: Arrowroot does not break clown as quickly as cornstarch, and it produces a slightly clearer finished product although it is much more expensive.
